```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    H1["**INPUTS**"] ~~~ H2{{"**ENGINES**"}} ~~~ H3(("**OUTPUTS**"))
    %% Input Sources

    MD[Markdown + LaTeX <br> + Python + etc.]
    LaTeX[LaTeX]
    Word[Word/Google Docs]
 
    %% Engines
    Web_Engine{{Pandoc/MathJax <br> or make4ht}}
    PDF_Engine{{latex/pdflatex/lualatex}}
    Quarto{{Quarto Engine}}
    Notebook{{Jupyter / Colab}}
    EXPORT{{Export }}

    %% To Engines
    LaTeX --> Web_Engine
    LaTeX ==> PDF_Engine
    MD ==> Notebook
    MD ==> Quarto
    Word --> EXPORT

    %% Final Output Formats
    SharedNB((Shared Notebook <br> on Colab))
    HTML((".html page <br>brightspace/github"))
    PDF(("Shared .pdf"))
    DOCX(("Shared Doc"))

    %% To Outputs
    Notebook ==> SharedNB
    Notebook ~~~ HTML
    Quarto --> PDF
    Quarto ==> HTML
    Quarto --> SharedNB
    PDF_Engine ==> PDF
    Web_Engine --> HTML 
    EXPORT --> PDF
    Word ===> DOCX

    %% Styling
    style SharedNB fill:#ffd, stroke:#000
    style PDF fill:#ffd,stroke:#000
    style HTML fill:#dfd,stroke:#000
    style DOCX fill:#ffd,stroke:#000
```
